activities.name: In this newly discovered campaign from TA505, threat actors targeted German companies with trojanized emails disguised as job applicants. While this activity appeared to be geographically based in Germany, these same techniques could easily be applied to any organization. Once the email attachment was activated, a company's secure credentials and credit card data could be transmitted covertly to the threat actors. In the 2019 iterations of this attack, TA505 used commercial tools to encrypt all the users files, which suggests this recent activity could also lay the groundwork for an infection vector into the company's network to encrypt files.
